prompt:
Image 1 is only a palette and art-style reference (Hiro the plain hero: grey steel armour over leather, a worn green cloak, a plain steel longsword with four tiny dull stones in its guard). Do NOT draw the character or the sword.

Create a 6-frame spell VFX sprite sheet, one continuous sequence: a BIG STEEL SLASH of a plain longsword, a wide crescent trail swept DOWNWARD from the top of the cell curving down to the lower part, bulging to the right. Off-white and steel grey, with four very thin faint coloured lines (dull red, blue, green, yellow) along its inner edge as the only colour, plain, no glow.
Frame 1: a thin line begins at the top. Frame 2: the crescent extends halfway down. Frame 3: the full crescent, about 80% of the cell height. Frame 4: the full arc holds. Frame 5: the arc thins and breaks. Frame 6: faint streaks.
PLAIN and MODEST: this is the free starter hero, so the effect is simple and down to earth. Painted as OPAQUE solid shapes with crisp edges: no glow halo, no haze, no sparkles, no gold light, no jewels, no rainbow colours, no magic runes. No pink, no purple, no magenta tint. Colours only white, steel grey, pale grey and the four faint dull lines.
Exactly 6 frames in a 3 columns x 2 rows grid of equal square 512x512 cells, total image 1536x1024, read left-to-right then next row. Nothing crosses a cell edge; leave a magenta margin of at least 8% on all sides of every cell. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta in every cell, no gradient, no text, no labels, no borders, no gridlines. Clean HD smooth painted anime game VFX, NOT pixel art.

precheck.summary: The candidate is a 3x2 grid of six crescent-slash frames on flat magenta, matching the requested sequence from thin line to faint streaks with no visible text, borders, or extra figures. Some arcs sit closer to the cell edges than the requested 8% margin, but that is a minor layout drift rather than a clear unusable defect.
